q: Are auto components covered by EU CBAM?
title: Are auto components covered by CBAM?
short: Mostly not. Parts of motor vehicles under CN 8708, and engine parts under chapter 84, are not in Annex I today. Some steel and aluminium goods auto suppliers ship are covered, such as bolts under 7318, tube fittings under 7307, other steel articles under 7326 and aluminium articles under 7616.
audience: Auto component exporters in Pune, Chennai, Gurugram and Rajkot

ul: 8708: parts and accessories of motor vehicles, such as brake parts, axles and gearboxes.
8409 and 8483: engine parts, crankshafts, gears and bearings housings.
8511 and 8544: ignition equipment and insulated wiring harnesses.

sections.h: Covered when declared under these headings
ul: 7318: screws, bolts, nuts and washers of iron or steel.
7307: tube or pipe fittings of iron or steel.
7326: other articles of iron or steel, which can include some forged or stamped parts not classified as vehicle parts.
7616: other articles of aluminium, which can include some aluminium castings.

p: Classification is by part, not by industry. Make a list of your EU part numbers with the CN code your buyer declares. Parts under covered headings need embedded emissions data; the rest do not, for now.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel and electricity bills into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input when a covered part needs embedded emissions data. Its CBAM calculator estimates certificate cost from 2026 to 2034.
